messages:
Alex Kim: Quick idea — show a 'credit-burn (smoothed)' overlay on the Embeddings Route page so teams can compare instantaneous token burn vs a smoothed signal. Right now console spikes make customers think we charged for transient bursts. cc @Maia

Maia Patel: Love that. Should the smoothing be per-route or per-tenant by default? Our router uses a 30s sliding window for circuit decisions.

Alex Kim: Default = per-route (most useful), with a switch to per-tenant aggregation. Proposed series: raw tokens/sec, EWMA-smoothed tokens/sec (configurable tau), and projected 1-min commit. Tooltip explains the math.

Tom G: Two quick ops concerns: 1) cardinality explosion if we emit smoothed for every route+model+tenant combination in the UI. 2) compute cost if we do EWMA on read.

Jess R: For UX, keep it simple: show raw vs smoothed for top-N routes by traffic, with an option to filter. Add a tiny inline explainer: 'Smoothed = 0.2*now + 0.8*prev (example)'. Helps support triage. :thumbsup:

Andrew S: Telemetry note: we already emit per-request token_count + route tag. Suggest adding a streaming aggregation that emits a per-(route,tenant) EWMA metric at 5s granularity so the console reads a single timeseries. That avoids heavy queries at render time.

Tom G: Agree on streaming. Maybe we can fold it into the existing ingest job and keep cardinality by only emitting for routes with >X TPS in the last 10m. We do that elsewhere for latency heatmaps.

Alex Kim: Good call. We should also surface the "circuit threshold" line on the graph so customers understand fallback triggers (e.g., when we switch to smaller model variant or enqueue).

Jess R: UX nit: show a small legend item for 'projected commit' with an explanation that it's a billing-facing estimate, not final charge. Avoid language like 'charge' — use 'estimated commit' to reduce alarm.

Andrew S: Sketch of a ksql-ish aggregator job (very rough):

```
CREATE STREAM requests (route VARCHAR, tenant VARCHAR, tokens BIGINT, ts TIMESTAMP) WITH (...);
CREATE TABLE ewma AS
  SELECT route, tenant,
    TS_ROWTIME_TO_WINDOW(ts, INTERVAL '5' SECOND) as win_end,
    PERSIST_EWMA(tokens, 0.2) as smoothed_tokens
  FROM requests
  GROUP BY route, tenant
  EMIT CHANGES;
```

(This would emit smoothed_tokens per 5s window that the console subscribes to.)

Maia Patel: Can we also backfill a 24h view so customers see how smoothing behaves over time? Not just live.

Alex Kim: Yes — store the emitted 5s smoothed series in TSDB (we already do for latency). UI can query by range. Backfill job can run once before rollout.

Tom G: Ops checklist: - Add cardinality guard (>0.5 TPS last 10m) - Emit only route+tenant (no model variant unless high traffic) - Retention 7d by default, 30d opt-in

Jess R: For rollout: 1) internal canary pages for platform/dev customers 2) opt-in beta flag in console 3) default on after 2 weeks if no big perf/cost surprises.

ingest-bot: job/ewma-aggregator created (job-ops-20240214-09).

Alex Kim: Action items: Maia to propose UI mockups, Andrew to draft aggregator query and estimate storage delta, Tom to add cardinality guard + run cost estimate, Jess to draft tooltip copy. I'll spin up a short RFC doc and link to it here tomorrow.

Jess R: Lovely. Thanks — this should reduce a lot of support noise around 'mysterious spikes'. :party_parrot:
